name: Marcus T.
text: The organic approach takes way longer but it actually builds real relationships with customers. I spent 3 months on cold outreach before my first 10 sales and it was worth every hour.

name: Sarah M.
text: Question: how do you handle rejection fatigue when doing manual outreach? I tried the no-ads route and burned out after month two.

name: David K.
text: Most founders skip it because they want instant results. This article nails it. I built my customer base through Twitter conversations and it completely changed my business.

name: Jennifer P.
text: Haven't tried all these tactics yet but the part about community building resonates with me. Does anyone have success with Reddit communities?

name: Robert L.
text: Good framework but honestly paid ads got me results faster and I could reinvest immediately. Different strokes I guess, but the organic path isn't for every business model.
